name: SBOM Generation
description: Generate SPDX and CycloneDX SBOMs for every build. Include dependency tree, licenses, and hashes.
purpose: Produce standards-compliant Software Bill of Materials for every build artifact so downstream consumers can verify what software is included, under what licenses, and at which versions.
acceptanceCriteria: SPDX 2.3 SBOM is generated for every production build.
CycloneDX 1.5 SBOM is generated for every production build.
SBOMs include full dependency tree (direct and transitive).
SBOMs include license information for every component.
SBOMs are published alongside build artifacts.
SBOM generation is validated (schema validation, hash consistency check).
